source_text: Mortuus est Iesus filius Nave centum decem annorum — sepultus in Thamnathsare. Dux temporalis transit; Iesus aeternus manet.
pass_a_gloss: Dead is Jesus son of-Nun one-hundred ten of-years — buried in Timnath-serah. Leader temporal passes; Jesus eternal remains.
pass_b_english: [[Jesus son of Nun dies at one hundred ten — buried at Timnath-serah >> Bible:Joshua 24:29-30]]. The temporal leader passes; the eternal Jesus remains.
